attr.title: Stardew Valley — RG34XXSP (KNULLI)
attr.desc: Stardew Valley mainline adaptation for Anbernic RG34XXSP on KNULLI, with built-in rumble, KNULLI battery HUD, preparation caching, CPU/rendering tuning and optional SMAPI. ARM64 release for 64-bit KNULLI.
attr.inst: Requires an owned Windows or Linux Steam .NET 6 mainline installation, 64-bit KNULLI and PortMaster. Copy the complete game into stardewvalleymainline/gamedata. Use Mods for user SMAPI mods. Enable vibration in the game and select the battery HUD in KNULLI. See the repository README for installation, upgrades and compatibility requirements.
